completion_decisions: Implement all three paper problems and all five paper-native algorithm-problem roles.
Use report polygons and wind arrays exactly; use a declared Figure-6 digitization for Stags and the pinned OpenWAKE lineage for Middelgrunden coordinates.
Implement the paper-required linear Larsen wake-deficit combination and fixed rotor quadrature in pure C++.

Replace the unavailable HAWC2-DWM load database with a deterministic nearest-wake analytic load surrogate while retaining paper component prices, Wohler exponents, degradation and maintenance equations.
Calibrate a case-wide wake scale only to the report's baseline 83.9% and 89.4% energy efficiencies; do not use optimized outputs as calibration targets.
Reconstruct HAWTOPT SLP as a deterministic move-limited linearized refinement with paper iteration counts and report move-limit range.
Implement the report binary SGA with population 20, crossover 0.70, per-bit mutation 0.025, two elites and rank fitness scaling 2.
Retain one run per role as the unreported native repeat protocol and add an explicitly labelled 25-seed robustness extension for stochastic SGA roles.

paper_problem_roles.2x3_slp: six NREL 5 MW turbines, reconstructed offshore depth field, pure level-2 SLP, 50 report-predecessor iterations
paper_problem_roles.2x3_sga: six NREL 5 MW turbines, level-1 binary SGA, 150 report-predecessor generations
paper_problem_roles.2x3_sga_slp: six NREL 5 MW turbines, 150-generation SGA followed by 50-iteration SLP
paper_problem_roles.stags_sga_slp: 17 Vestas V80 turbines, report polygon and wind resource, 1000-generation SGA followed by 30-iteration SLP
paper_problem_roles.middelgrunden_sga_slp: 20 Bonus B80/B76 turbines, report polygon and wind resource, 1000-generation SGA followed by 20-iteration SLP

physics_and_cost.wind_states: 12 directions times 12 speeds from 4 to 26 m/s in 2 m/s increments; direction probabilities and Weibull/TI tables from Risoe-R-1768
physics_and_cost.level1: fixed 2-by-2 aggregation to 36 probability-preserving direction-speed cells
physics_and_cost.wake: Risoe-R-1713 stationary semi-analytical Larsen kernel, paper linear deficit superposition, rotor quadrature and smooth disclosed power/CT replacement curves
physics_and_cost.financial_balance: 20-year power value at 50 EUR/MWh minus degradation and maintenance minus financed foundation and cable investment using 2.5% inflation and 6.5% interest
physics_and_cost.foundation: 20% turbine cost at 8 m plus 2% turbine cost per metre depth deviation; onshore foundation term constant and omitted
physics_and_cost.cables: deterministic closest-group minimum spanning construction; 675 EUR/m offshore and 270 EUR/m onshore
physics_and_cost.minimum_spacing: one rotor diameter, retained as the paper's explicit blade-contact benchmark rule

algorithm.slp_initial_move_limit_fraction: 0.00625 for Stags and 0.025 for the other cases, within the report 0.625%-2.5% range

formal_protocol.formal_resource_mapping: independent single-worker seed processes scheduled across every available Waffle CPU core
reported_outputs: initial and final financial balance and all subcomponents
AEP, energy efficiency, cable length and final layout
stage iterations and physical objective-evaluation ledger
worker receipt, scientific hash, source commit and executable hash

hpc_execution.evaluator_axis: independent direction-speed states with fixed slots and ordered annual/load reduction
hpc_execution.sga_axis: all 20 complete individual layouts evaluated concurrently before ordered rank selection and frozen generation commit
hpc_execution.slp_axis: all plus/minus finite-difference layouts and line-search trial layouts evaluated concurrently before ordered move-limit update
hpc_execution.determinism: counter-keyed random events, fixed layouts and fixed reductions preserve one/all-core scientific identity
hpc_execution.h6: one versus every Waffle core for complete Stags and Middelgrunden 1000-generation SGA plus native SLP workflows
hpc_execution.nested_oversubscription: forbidden; population/trial parallelism uses serial inner wind-state evaluation, while standalone layout evaluation partitions wind states
